name: cpi_component_weights_canada
source: Statistics Canada Web Data Service (lifted from boc-tracker)
source_id: Table 18-10-0004-01 + Table 18-10-0007-01 per-component vectors and 2024-basket weight values
units: Component CPI vector mapping + 2024 basket weight (% of all-items)
notes: Per-component CPI vector IDs (cpi_vector) and 2024 basket weights (wt_value, % share of all-items). Lifted from boc-tracker/data/cpi_breadth_mapping.json on 2026-05-11. 60-component basket; weights sum to ~99% (minor categories excluded). Used by the CPI breadth derivation (share-of-basket-with-yoy-gt-3) and any future tilt/distribution charts. Component names align with the column headers in data/raw/cpi_components.csv.
